schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY
schemes.summary: World's largest health insurance scheme providing free health insurance up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for vulnerable families.
schemes.description: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY is a national health protection scheme that provides health insurance coverage to vulnerable families. It covers hospitalization costs, pre-hospitalization, and post-hospitalization treatment.
benefits: Coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year

schemes.name: Reproductive & Maternal Health
schemes.summary: Government initiative providing free maternal health services, antenatal care, and delivery services across rural and urban areas.
schemes.description: RMHP focuses on providing safe and dignified pregnancy, childbirth, and post-natal care. It ensures every woman has access to quality maternal health services.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram
schemes.summary: Comprehensive health scheme for children providing screening, diagnosis, and treatment of diseases at school and community levels.
schemes.description: RBSK provides health screening and treatment for children from birth to 18 years in schools and communities to ensure better child health outcomes.

schemes.name: National Jal Jeevan Mission
schemes.summary: Initiative to provide safe and adequate drinking water to every household through functional tap connections in villages.
schemes.description: NJJM aims to provide tap water connection to every household in rural India, ensuring safe drinking water and reducing waterborne diseases.

schemes.name: Mission Indradhanush
schemes.summary: Campaign to improve immunization coverage by rapidly increasing vaccination rates across all age groups.
schemes.description: Mission Indradhanush aims to vaccinate all children and pregnant women against vaccine-preventable diseases through intensive and targeted immunization campaigns.

schemes.name: National Urban Health Mission
schemes.summary: Scheme to provide primary health care services to urban poor and homeless population through Urban Health Centers.
schemes.description: NUHM provides primary health care services including maternal and child health, family planning, and disease control services to urban populations.

schemes.name: National Programme for Control of Blindness
schemes.summary: Program to eliminate avoidable blindness through prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation services.
schemes.description: NPCB aims to reduce the burden of avoidable blindness and visual impairment through early detection, treatment, and rehabilitation.

schemes.name: National TB Elimination Programme
schemes.summary: Program to eliminate tuberculosis through early detection, treatment, and prevention services completely free.
schemes.description: NTEP aims to achieve TB elimination through universal access to rapid diagnosis, treatment, and care with free medicines and diagnostics.

schemes.name: National Malaria Elimination Programme
schemes.summary: Program to eliminate malaria through surveillance, vector control, diagnosis, and treatment services.
schemes.description: NMEP aims to eliminate malaria by providing free diagnosis, treatment, and prevention services across all areas.

schemes.name: ASHA Scheme
schemes.summary: Accredited Social Health Activists provide maternal and child health services at grassroots level in every village.
schemes.description: ASHA workers serve as bridge between community and health system, providing health awareness, maternal and child health services.
schemes.coverage: All rural areas and urban slums
